PANTY.gloss: short underpants for women or children
PANTY.definition: Short underpants for women or children (usually used in the plural).

PANT.gloss: breathe noisily, as when one is exhausted
PANT.definition: Breathe noisily, as when one is exhausted.
PANT.example: The runners reached the finish line, panting heavily.

ANY.gloss: one or some or every or all without specification
ANY.definition: One or some or every or all without specification.
ANY.example: Give me any peaches you don't want.

PAY.gloss: give money, usually in exchange for goods or services
PAY.definition: Give money, usually in exchange for goods or services.
PAY.example: I paid four dollars for this sandwich.

TAP.gloss: cut a female screw thread with a tap
TAP.definition: Cut a female screw thread with a tap.

PAT.gloss: pat or squeeze fondly or playfully, especially under the chin
PAT.definition: Pat or squeeze fondly or playfully, especially under the chin.

TAN.gloss: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun
TAN.definition: A browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun.

PAN.example: The camera panned across the room.

ANT.gloss: social insect living in organized colonies
ANT.definition: Social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers.

NAP.gloss: a period of time spent sleeping
NAP.definition: A period of time spent sleeping.
NAP.example: He felt better after a little sleep.

APT.example: He is apt to ignore matters he considers unimportant.
